title: Sliding Mode Controller
text: Hysteresis-based sliding mode control, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Sliding factor}, {Hysteresis band} sets the total hysteresis bandwidth, {Control action upper limit} controls signal upper limit, u max, {Control action lower limit} controls signal lower limit, u min and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Control action upper limit
params.values: Control signal upper limit, u max 10 (default) | scalar greater than the value of the Control action lower limit parameter

params.name: Control action lower limit
params.values: Control signal lower limit, u min -10 (default) | scalar
